### Borea v0.6.0-dev.3: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.6.0 before it is released.
It is not for users.
For normal use, stay on v0.5.2.
It builds on v0.6.0-dev.2, and the list below covers only what changed since that build.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Please test these first

- The mouse wheel over an open drop-down.
  Open the license list on the Describe step of a share, and other short drop-downs, and turn the mouse wheel over them.
  Borea must not freeze, and the page behind the list must stay where it is.
- The share steps on a wide window.
  Share a vehicle or a save in a window of about 1600 or 2000 px.
  The steps must use the width, with the side panel next to them.
- On Linux: set a game folder whose path differs from the one in `StarMapConfig.json` only in letter case, and start the instance.
  Borea must keep the path that you set.
- Simplified Chinese: switch the language to Simplified Chinese and go through the share steps, the Update all window and the Statistics tab.
- Going back: after you tested, read "Before you go back to v0.5.2" in the notes of v0.6.0-dev.2, and then start v0.5.2 again.
  Nothing new to know since that build.

#### New since v0.6.0-dev.2

- Borea no longer freezes when you turn the mouse wheel over an open drop-down whose list cannot scroll, such as the license list of a share.
  A wheel over an open drop-down also no longer moves the page behind it.
- The share steps take the width of the page, so the side panel stands next to them and "Start over" ends where they end.
  At 860 and 1000 px the page looks as before.
- On Linux, a game folder whose path differs from the loader's only in letter case is no longer overwritten, because Linux treats those as two different folders.
  Windows and macOS behave as before.
- The Simplified Chinese texts are complete again: the share steps, pictures and covers, the Statistics tab, Home, the install steps, the conflict window, the preview and the Update all window.
  The saved archive message no longer shows the size unit twice.
- A test of the install choices no longer fails at random on slow computers.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on.
When v0.6.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
